text: PALM admission binds the model contract, objective and operator identities, coercive or compact level-set evidence, blockwise proper-closed-convex and positive partial-Lipschitz witnesses, and exact or geometrically summable inexactness. Singular normalization requires support or quotient semantics. A critical-point claim additionally requires objective-bound KL/semi-algebraic evidence; without it, convergence is only coordinatewise stationary. Runtime enforces monotonicity or sufficient decrease and checks both inexactness and subproblem residuals. Generic factored PALM can never issue a global claim; convex nuclear-norm global admission is a separate certificate gate.
